name: AlphaESS Cloud API
description: AlphaESS Cloud API integration for remote data collection
author: Wolffie

collector.description: Collects data from AlphaESS Cloud API every 2 minutes

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Serves as automatic failover when AlphaESS ModBus TCP is unreachable
All capabilities registered at priority 5 — lower than ModBus TCP (10) so failover is seamless
grid:status capability intentionally NOT implemented — Cloud API does not expose inverter operating mode (INV_WORK_MODE register 0x0440). Grid outage detection requires ModBus TCP.

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: NULL for unowned/unavailable fields instead of 0 to prevent AVG() dilution in aggregation
Timestamps written in local time (CET/CEST) to match all other collectors

changelog.author: Wolffie
changes: Initial release — AlphaESS Cloud API integration
Collects battery, solar, grid and load data every 2 minutes
Provides battery:read, solar:read, grid:read, home:read and battery control capabilities
Cloud API requires app_id, app_secret and system_sn credentials
